lead_independence.headline: Vero Beach High School honors student killed in fall at abandoned Sebastian condo
lead_independence.lead: Students, family members and friends gathered at Billy Livings Field during Vero Beach High School's season opener Friday night to honor the memory of 16-year-old Roylynn Scott. Members of the Vero Beach High School band took the field wearing purple ribbons, Roylynn's favorite color, as classmates, teachers, teammates and loved ones filled the stands before kickoff. At her parents' request, the stadium announcer addressed the crowd, sharing details about Roylynn's life, including her love of football games, her passion for art and the impact she had on those around her. The remarks were followed by a moment of silence.
